title: Modular word evaluation
statement: For a natural number $k$, a function $a :  br_{	ext{nat}} 	o  br_{	ext{nat}}$, a list $vs$ of natural numbers, and a Boolean list $w$, define its value by cases: for a variable word, take the value of $a$ at the length of its first argument modulo $k$; for a one word, take $1$ modulo $k$; for an addition word, add the entries of $vs$ indexed by the lengths of its two arguments, using $0$ when an index is out of range, and reduce modulo $k$; for a subtraction word, add the first such entry to $k$ minus the second and reduce modulo $k$; in every other case, multiply the two entries and reduce modulo $k$.
caveat: The variable, one, addition, subtraction, and argument tests or extractors are not defined in the supplied material; the displayed natural-number type notation is described in words rather than as a project macro.
